## Berlin 3-Bedroom Viewing Plan for 2026-07-01 to 2026-07-03
Media: Icon=https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/bootstrap-icons@1.11.3/icons/house.svg

A focused 3-day viewing plan for Berlin rentals that fit your core filters: **up to €2,400/month**, **near transit**, **pet-friendly for one cat**, and **80 m²+**. I’m assuming you want to schedule 1–2 viewings per day and compare each flat against the same checklist.

## Prioritized Viewing Checklist and Appointment Plan
| Priority | What to verify | Why it matters | How to check fast |
|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | Total monthly rent and included costs | Confirms the flat stays within budget | Ask for cold rent, warm rent, heating, utilities, and any parking/storage fees |
| 2 | Transit access | Important for daily commuting and resale demand | Walk to nearest U-Bahn/S-Bahn/Tram stop and time it yourself |
| 3 | Cat policy | Avoids later lease problems | Get pet permission in writing and ask for any breed/number restrictions |
| 4 | Usable size and layout | Ensures the apartment truly works for 3 bedrooms | Measure room sizes, hallway width, and storage space |
| 5 | Heating, windows, and energy costs | Impacts comfort and monthly expenses | Check boiler type, insulation, window condition, and energy certificate |
| 6 | Noise and light | Affects long-term livability | Visit at a busy time if possible; open windows and listen for street/train noise |
| 7 | Building condition and maintenance | Signals future repair issues | Look at stairwell, facade, entry system, and signs of moisture or mold |
| 8 | Lease terms and move-in timing | Prevents surprises after approval | Confirm minimum term, deposit, start date, and required documents |

### Day 1: 2026-07-01 — Shortlist and First Viewings
Media: Icon=https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/bootstrap-icons@1.11.3/icons/calendar.svg
- Morning: Confirm 2–3 appointments in transit-rich areas with strong commuter links.
- Afternoon: Visit first flat; test walking time to the nearest station and inspect room sizes.
- Evening: Send follow-up questions and request the energy certificate, floor plan, and rent breakdown.

### Day 2: 2026-07-02 — Compare Layout and Building Quality
Media: Icon=https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/bootstrap-icons@1.11.3/icons/building.svg
- Morning: View the second apartment and compare natural light, storage, and bedroom separation.
- Afternoon: Check building entry, cellar/bike storage, elevator access, and any renovation history.
- Evening: Rank the flat against your budget, transit access, and cat approval certainty.

### Day 3: 2026-07-03 — Final Candidate and Decision Check
Media: Icon=https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/bootstrap-icons@1.11.3/icons/check2-circle.svg
- Morning: Revisit the best option if possible, ideally at a different time of day.
- Afternoon: Verify lease conditions, deposit amount, move-in date, and landlord responsiveness.
- Evening: Prepare documents and send your preferred application quickly if the flat fits.

## Landlord Message Template for an Appointment Request
Media: Icon=https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/bootstrap-icons@1.11.3/icons/chat-left-text.svg

Subject: Viewing request for 3-bedroom apartment in Berlin

Hello [Landlord/Property Manager Name],

I am interested in the 3-bedroom apartment in Berlin and would like to request a viewing appointment between **2026-07-01 and 2026-07-03**.

My requirements are:
- Monthly rent up to **€2,400**
- Minimum size of **80 m²**
- Close to public transit
- Pet-friendly for **one cat**

I would be happy to receive any available viewing times, along with the floor plan, rent details, and energy certificate if available.

Thank you for your time, and I look forward to your reply.

Kind regards,
[Your Full Name]
[Phone Number]
[Email Address]

## Quick Actions
Action: [Button: Search listings] https://www.immobilienscout24.de/
Action: [Button: Berlin transit map] https://www.bvg.de/
Action: [Button: Rental rights info] https://www.berlin.de/sen/wohnen/

## Sources
- Berlin housing portal: https://www.berlin.de/sen/wohnen/
- BVG public transit: https://www.bvg.de/
- Rental market listings: https://www.immobilienscout24.de/
